decision.rationale: This official Faculty of Applied Science strategic-plan homepage explains its educational mission, academic organization, priorities and investment framework. It explicitly serves campuses in Vancouver and Kelowna, so it is not Okanagan-exclusive. Its visible academic-school and department sections support academics as the host default; no separate announcement, profile, research-output, application-call or practical-help section is evidenced.
evidence: https://strategicplan.apsc.ubc.ca/ | b702e39fde28c7277022bdf50e13ecb94996bed8cd8c0cba8cf80e553e4f8b08 | The Faculty of Applied Science comprises a unique constellation of disciplines. Our core purpose is to discover, design, innovate, provide unwavering top-tier education and champion a community of responsible professionals.

https://strategicplan.apsc.ubc.ca/ | b702e39fde28c7277022bdf50e13ecb94996bed8cd8c0cba8cf80e553e4f8b08 | The priorities and strategies in the plan form a framework for decision-making and investment across the Faculty.

https://strategicplan.apsc.ubc.ca/ | b702e39fde28c7277022bdf50e13ecb94996bed8cd8c0cba8cf80e553e4f8b08 | The location of our campuses in Vancouver and Kelowna allows us to leverage a diverse and inclusive international culture while respecting the rich Indigenous heritage in British Columbia.

fallback.rationale: The site documents the Applied Science faculty's academic mission, organization and strategic priorities for education and professional disciplines across its campuses.
